IT IS NO LONGER THE WHOLE FILE and the sentence that said so is retracted: `checkSpecialSpectralConditions` now lives in the same source and is the `v90specialcond` set, against `build/test/t_v90specialcond`, because t_v90spectral does not reach it and a set run against a binary that cannot reach its half reads NOT CAUGHT for every entry.  The reciprocal entry below is the one that matters most -- objdump prints the object's `de f9` as `fdivrp` and it IS `FDIVP` (finding 245), so a reconstruction that believed the mnemonic would divide the other way round and BOTH sides of a side-against-side comparison would agree.  t_v90spectral.cpp computes the quotient itself and compares the bit pattern, which is what makes that entry catchable at all.  The store order of the eight words is not mutated: no observer can distinguish it.  The `edprintf` in reset() is not mutated either -- its transcript is compared in t_v90leaves.cpp, not here.
